description: “Illinois Attorney General Kwame Raoul has claimed victory in a legal battle against the Trump administration over noncitizens’ access to a host of publicly funded health, education and social service programs. A federal judge in Rhode Island on Monday struck down the administration’s attempt to require states to verify a person’s citizenship or lawful immigration […]
